head: codex/604-v2-publish-ready-reconciliation-exec
title: [C-SDLC v2] Restore governed draft-to-ready publication reconciliation
body:
Closes #604

Summary:
- Restores typed `csdlc-publish ready` and `csdlc-publish reconcile-ready` for governed draft-to-ready publication reconciliation.
- Revalidates live PR repository, number, base, head branch, exact head SHA, open state, draft state, and observed body linkage before recording ready truth.
- Publishes the new ready request schemas and records full-cycle canary defects found while testing #604.
- Fixes ready/reconcile-ready metadata tails so ready publication truth is committed, pushed, reobserved, and verified as a metadata-only follow-up.
- Fixes already-published resume handling so an advanced local evidence head is pushed before remote reobservation.
- Fixes retained PR-state action-envelope compatibility for direct PR-state readback commands.
- Fixes self-staling review-scope assignment by rejecting `.csdlc/issues/<issue>` lifecycle scopes before assignment mutation.
- Fixes retained terminal prerequisite digest fixtures for #298 and #299 so the full standalone suite matches live derived-terminal receipts.
- Narrows terminal-authority deletion tests so `ReconcileReady` remains a publication/readiness reconciliation route, not terminal authority.
- Records and recovers the canary review-visibility defect so the final review evidence is tied to an operator-visible PASS transcript.

- `.csdlc/prepared/issues/604/validate-implementation.sh`
- `TMPDIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-cargo-targets/issue-604-test-tmp cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --test gate10a`
- `TMPDIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-cargo-targets/issue-604-test-tmp cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --test gate5 review_assignment_rejects_self_staling_lifecycle_scope`

- `TMPDIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-cargo-targets/issue-604-test-tmp cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --test gate_terminal_authority_deletion`
- `TMPDIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-cargo-targets/issue-604-test-tmp cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --test projection_recovery_integration terminal_prerequisites_are_current_and_ancestral_to_execution_base`
- `TMPDIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-cargo-targets/issue-604-test-tmp cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml`
- `TMPDIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-cargo-targets/issue-604-test-tmp cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings`

- `csdlc-validate issue --issue 604`

Review:
- Final visible subagent review: `/root/review_604_tiny_visible_final` PASS at assigned substantive revision `ed1f44d02db4ceecdf8e833ad33ffb205b3a3c5e`.
- Later commits before publication are C-SDLC review/publication metadata only.

Canary notes:
- This PR deliberately published as draft first, then was marked ready through the new typed ready command to exercise the full #604 path.
- The canary exposed and fixed ready metadata-tail, publication-resume push, retained PR-state envelope, self-staling review-scope, terminal-authority guard, retained terminal digest fixture, and review-visibility defects before cutover.
- Typed PR-state readback must confirm PR #610 is open, non-draft, linked to #604 by GitHub closing reference, and current at this head before merge.
